articles.summary: Fluor Corporation (NYSE: FLR) announced today that it has signed a definitive engineering, procurement and construction contract with TeraWulf for the development and construction of three data center buildings at the Justified Data Campus in Hawesville, Kentucky. Fluor expects to recognize the award in the fourth quarter upon finalization of pricing for the first two buildings. The contract is structured under which Fluor is responsible for cost overruns up to a percentage of its profit. articles.title: Fluor Signs EPC Contract with TeraWulf for Large-Scale Data Center Campus in Kentucky

articles.summary: Fluor Corporation (NYSE: FLR) announced today that it has been selected by X-Energy, Inc. to provide engineering, design, and project management services for the Cascade Advanced Energy Facility, an advanced small modular reactor project near Richland, Washington. Fluor will recognize the undisclosed contract value in the third quarter. A rendering of X-energy’s Cascade Advanced Energy Facility near Richland, Washington. “Advanced nuclear technologies are poised to play a critical role in meeting growing energy demand while supporting decarbonization goals,” said Pierre Bechelany, Fluor’s Business Group President of Energy Solutions. “The Cascade Advanced Energy Facility represents an important step forward in the deployment of next-generation nuclear energy. articles.summary: Fluor Corporation (NYSE: FLR) announced today that it has received full notice to proceed under its engineering, procurement and construction management contract with Sierra Gorda Sociedad Contractual Minera (SGSCM) for the Fourth Grinding Line Expansion Project in Chile. Fluor will recognize the undisclosed contract value in the third quarter of 2026. Located approximately 60 kilometers south of Calama in Chile’s Antofagasta Region, SGSCM operates a large-scale open-pit copper-molybdenum mine. The brownfield expansion will add a fourth process line, including a new primary crusher, a high-pressure grinding roll crusher, fine ore grinding, flotation and associated support facilities. articles.title: Fluor Granted Full Notice to Proceed on Sierra Gorda’s Fourth Grinding Line Expansion Project in Chile
